purpose: Research on kidney function in people with diabetes to update a teaching module.
question: What is the mean eGFR of adults with type 2 diabetes, by age band?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Use the latest eGFR (LOINC 62238-1) per patient; patients without an eGFR are left out.
Report per band: adults with type 2 diabetes who have an eGFR value and their mean eGFR, one decimal.
